title: Competency questions: model answers and the why layer
subtitle: Ten model answers taken apart, the one sentence that carries your thinking, and your house story built out for five questions.

points.head: A real why is something you noticed.
points.text: It is not the action said again.

points.head: One sentence carries it.
points.text: I noticed this, so I did that, and not the other, because…

points.head: One story, different moments.
points.text: Pressure and deadlines can use the same story. You tell a different part.

how: Coloured boxes show example words. Grey is a weak answer, green is a strong one, blue is a line to say out loud.
Sam, who gives the model answers, is made up. Square brackets mark things only you know.
